description: Fetch one ITALIAN public-procurement notice by its CIG (Codice Identificativo Gara — the unique id ANAC assigns every public contract above a minimal threshold) from the ANAC "cig" register. Returns the full record: title, buyer (with tax code), province/region, contract type, amount, lot count, sector, procedure type, realization mode, CPV code/description, publish date, offer deadline, and outcome (aggiudicata/revocata/etc.) with its communication date when ANAC has recorded one. Use after it_tender_search returns a CIG.

cig.description: The notice's CIG, e.g. "B82436559F". Returned by it_tender_search.
